sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Giddiness.

Eye .—Desire to keep the eyelids closed.—Imperfect vision, the pecu¬
liarity being that half an object only could be seen at once.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text: Loss of appetite.—Nausea.—Feeling of discomfort in the

sections.label: stomach
sections.text:
Generalities. —I became greatly disordered, and felt and looked
wretchedly ill ; a perceptible derangement of the whole system, which
could not, without danger, have been carried further.
